notes.title: Official release! v1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

The wait is over, the game is now officially released and it's early access period is over!
Thanks for the support from the guys who voted for our game in greenlight and from those who played our game in the early access period and provided some very valuable feedback!

Please enjoy what we have created, it was a hell of a ride.

From now on we are focusing on community management and small bug and balance fixes if we find any problem. Please leave your feedback about the game in the comment section so we can adjust the game if necessary.

Have fun!

Best regards, 
RandG Games.

notes.title: Achievements update! v0.70
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

With this patch we add the long awaited achievement system to the game with twenty unlockable ahievements!

Changes: 
- Some bug fixes
- Balance adjustments
- Inventory system update (double click to take stack added)
- New recipe: two wooden stick from one log
- New setting at world creation: evolution speed
- New craftable item: raft with chest
- Unlockable achievements added


Please, leave your feedback about the changes in the comment section and 
keep an eye out for the upcoming updates. 

Best regards, 
RandG Games.

notes.title: Third person view update! v0.06
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

With this update finally the third person view is back as an optional mode so now you can use that or the first person view as well. The default button for camera mode change is "c", but in some cases you need to rebind it before use. The other big thing is farming, from now on you can build a garden and grow plants for food and later herbs for potions. We updated our game wiki with every bit of information you need.

 Fleeting Ages Wiki

Changes: 

- Third person view is back in the game
- Farming is now available
- Craftable and placeable small and large garden added
- Craftable stone hoe added
- Carrot and Cabbage plant added with corresponding seeds
- Carrot and cabbage soup added as cookable consumable
- Some models and animations were updated


Please, leave your feedback about the changes in the comment section and 
keep an eye out for the upcoming updates. 

Best regards, 
RandG Games.

notes.title: New update! v0.05
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

This is a bigger update which contains some tweaks and adjustments to the game balance and some performance optimization. The bronze age is back with this update and some new game mechanics too.
We put together a simple wiki page for our game to help you guys with crafting etc. Link is down below.

 Fleeting Ages Wiki

Changes: 

- New age: Bronze age
- New items: ( bronze ingot, bronze sword, copper arrow )
- Fishing is now in the game
- Craftable fishing rod, catchable and cookable fish
- Cut down trees in forest biomes now have a chance to drop apples
- Most of the animals now are affraid of fire so you can defend your camp with fireplaces and torches
- The players and enemies now catch on fire if they walk into one
(lasts a few secons and does damage, you can extinguish it by jumping into water)
- The weapons and tools are now last longer, foods refills more of your hunger bar


Please, leave your feedback about the changes in the comment section and 
keep an eye out for the upcoming updates. 

Best regards, 
RandG Games.

notes.title: Small update! v0.04
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

This small update contains some new game mechanics and
balance updates refering to your feedback. Some old features
are coming back with this patch too.

Changes: 

- Caves are back in the game
- New stamina bar to balance your activeness
- Some vegetation and fishes added to the underwater world
- New craftable item: Raft, to travel big bodies of water faster
- Some balance tweaks to the hunger and enemy aggro systems
- New playable game mode: Advanced mode, every age is unlocked from
  the start so you can try out everything in the game  

Notes: 
-saved games may be lost 
(Sorry, but because of the cave generation some of you can't load back your saved games. If the loading stops with an error please start a new game.) 


Please, leave your feedback about the changes in the comment section and 
keep an eye out for the upcoming updates. 

Best regards, 
RandG Games.

notes.title: Our next update is live now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

With this update the next big age the Tin age is now playable
again. In the next patch the fourth age is coming back so
stay tuned.

Changes:

- New copper weapon for the previous age (Copper mace)
- The third age is back in the game (The tin age)
- Mineable tin is back
- Every item for the tin age is back with improved models 
(Second tier workbench, woodcutter, copper anvil, chest etc.)
- New tin weapons and tools added
- New item: Bucket, for water collection
- New item: Cauldron, for second tier cooking
- New item: Soup, cookable in a cauldron
- New item: Palisade, buildable to protect your home
- A new house for the new age
- Enemies now destroy player houses and palisades
- New item: Stone hammer, for repairing damaged items
- New clothes: Hard leather boots, trousers and vest
- New Enemy type: Bow users

Notes: 
-saved games may be lost 
(Sorry, but because of the changes in ore generation some of you can't load
back your saved games. If the loading stops with an error please start a new game.) 


Please, leave your feedback about the changes in the comment section and 
keep an eye out for the upcoming updates. 

Best regards, 
RandG Games.

notes.title: Big update and more coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Our new update is live now. Sorry for the wait but this is 
a big one and there will be more coming as we progressively 
rework every part of the game. Because of the engine change
for now only the first age is playable, but they will be added back
one by one in the next weeks. 

The old version of the game will still be available through Steam's beta function. You can access it by right clicking on Fleeting Ages in your game library then choosing Properties then Betas. In the drop down menu select the "oldversion" option then steam will download the old version for you. 
You can change your version whenever you want.

Changes:

- Updated the game engine from Unity 4 to Unity 5
- The all new first person view is now the default 
  (Third person view coming back later as an option.)
- Updated terrain generation and textures
- Added biomes to the terrain to make it more diverse
- Updated foliage, trees and all new game effects
- New animal models and animations
- Two new animal types in the stone age (Mammoth and Saber Tooth Tiger) 
- New house models
- New menu and inventory system
- New water and underwater effects
- Updated weather system
-  A lot of other, less significant changes

Notes: 
-saved games will be lost 
(Sorry, but because of the new engine we can't load your saved games.) 


Please, leave your feedback about the changes in the comment section and
keep an eye out for the upcoming updates.

Best regards, 
RandG Games.
